evals.prompt: Use my logged-in browser to ask Perplexity Deep Research for a sourced answer about the latest AI model evaluation trends, save the conversation as eval-research, and return JSON metadata.
evals.expected_output: Uses the ai-chat skill with provider perplexity, model perplexity/deep-research, long timeout, save-conversation eval-research, JSON output, and metadata including provider state.
expectations: The run uses scripts/ai-chat.mjs --provider perplexity --model perplexity/deep-research.
The run uses --save-conversation eval-research and --json.
The output includes provider_state.backend_uuid or a clear provider error.
The output includes model, requested_model, complete, captured_at, and response.

evals.prompt: Continue the Perplexity conversation eval-research and ask a follow-up without resending the full previous answer. Return JSON.
evals.expected_output: Uses --conversation eval-research so the saved provider thread is continued by backend uuid and read-write token.
expectations: The run uses scripts/ai-chat.mjs --provider perplexity --conversation eval-research.
The output uses the same saved conversation id.
The provider state is preserved or updated.
The run does not replay full chat history manually.

evals.prompt: List and live-verify the available Perplexity models for my current account, including thinking levels, Pro or Max tier, default model, task defaults, and whether chats save to library by default. Return JSON.
evals.expected_output: Uses --list-models --verify-models for provider perplexity and returns the network-contract registry with model ids, display names, mode, tier, Thinking metadata, history policy, task defaults, and account availability.
expectations: The run uses scripts/ai-chat.mjs --provider perplexity --list-models --verify-models --json.
The output includes perplexity/deep-research and the captured openai/gpt-5.6-terra Thinking pair.
The output includes only captured or live-verified network identifiers and includes OpenAI GPT-5.6 Terra, Perplexity Sonar 2, and NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra Thinking.
The output includes min_tier, mode, thinking, thinking_level, available, default_model, task_models, and history_policy.

evals.prompt: Use Grok Fast to start a thread about oil-market scenarios, save it as oil-scenarios, then continue the same Grok thread with a follow-up. Return JSON and screenshot evidence.
evals.expected_output: Uses Grok browser UI, verifies Fast model, saves and reopens the conversation URL, and captures a screenshot showing the continued thread.
expectations: The first run uses --provider grok --model fast --save-conversation oil-scenarios.
The follow-up uses --conversation oil-scenarios.
The output includes a stable conversation_url.
A screenshot path is included or saved under /tmp.

evals.prompt: For Gemini, use the Browser Tools managed browser started with the Gemini-capable profile to discover and live-verify account model choices, then run a reasoning task using the task default. Report JSON and do not save to Gemini history unless explicitly requested.
evals.expected_output: Uses --provider gemini --list-models --verify-models with managed-browser cookies, reports account-specific models from the Gemini RPC, then uses --task reasoning for a temporary chat.
expectations: The model list run uses scripts/ai-chat.mjs --provider gemini --list-models --verify-models --json with Browser Tools managed-browser cookies.
The output includes account_specific true or a clear discovery error.
The output includes default_model, task_models, history_policy, available, and verification.status.
The reasoning task output has model_task reasoning, is_temporary true, saved_to_library false, and a non-empty chrome_profile value.

evals.prompt: Ask Perplexity with GPT-5.6 Terra Thinking enabled, stream the answer, and prove from metadata that it used the network-only path. Do not parse or automate the Perplexity page UI.
evals.expected_output: Uses --provider perplexity --model openai/gpt-5.6-terra --thinking --stream --json. The selected model is the captured Thinking variant and provider state proves browser-network-sse with no DOM processing.
expectations: The run selects openai/gpt-5.6-terra with --thinking and reports selected_model openai/gpt-5.6-terra-thinking.
The output reports provider_state.transport browser-network-sse, network_only true, and dom_processing false.
The stream completes from SSE state and does not use rendered HTML, selectors, element clicks, typing, or DOM fallback.
No Perplexity cookie, owner token, or read-write token appears in public output.

evals.prompt: Ask Perplexity this question in Incognito so it is not saved to my provider history. Return JSON that proves the private mode was accepted, and do not use the page UI at runtime.
evals.expected_output: Uses --provider perplexity --incognito --json through browser-network-sse. Safe provider state reports explicit Incognito, provider privacy state, expiry, and no history save.
expectations: The run uses scripts/ai-chat.mjs --provider perplexity --incognito --json.
The request sends params.is_incognito true and does not send a separate Incognito mode API call.
Provider state reports is_incognito true, incognito_explicit true, privacy_state INCOGNITO, ephemeral true, saved_to_library false, and provider expiry metadata; the local response cache is bypassed.
The run rejects --incognito together with --save-to-library or --space-uuid before network use.
No rendered HTML, element interaction, DOM fallback, cookie value, owner token, or read-write token appears in the runtime path or public output.
